title: Internal step exactly at the exception limit
why: 230 mm is allowed only if the step count is reduced, which the spec cannot show.

spec.name: Internal step exactly at the exception limit

steps.internal_step_height_mm.required: ≤ 200 mm, or ≤ 230 mm if it reduces the number of steps
steps.internal_step_height_mm.rationale: 4.2.2.11.2(2): 230 exceeds 200; the 230 mm maximum is allowed only 'if it can be demonstrated that this achieves a reduction of one in the total number of steps'. The spec has no such data: a person must decide.
